step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the actor/environment: A developer laptop / CI/CD environment represented in the purple cluster on the left, mapped to the actor UserCompanyDeveloper.
2. Identify AWS Service nodes drawn on the whiteboard:
   - AWS Cognito (Cognito icon at the bottom left)
   - Amazon S3 (S3 icon at top middle)
   - AWS Lambda (Lambda icon at top right)
   - Amazon DynamoDB (DynamoDB icon at bottom center)
   - Amazon CloudWatch (CloudWatch icon at bottom right)
3. Trace drawn arrows/edges:
   - Laptop -> Cognito: Authentication call.
   - Laptop -> S3: Upload execution bundle 'xyz'.
   - Laptop -> Lambda: Invoke ~700 Lambda executions in parallel.
   - S3 -> Lambda: Lambda downloads the execution bundle 'xyz'.
   - Lambda -> Laptop: Lambda returns response JSON back to Laptop.
4. DynamoDB and CloudWatch icons are visually present on the whiteboard without explicitly drawn arrows, so they are extracted as unconnected nodes per visual-first rules.
